verdict.rationale: Access control is a fair question for a database, but the evidence pack never mentions API keys, roles, RBAC or per-collection permissions. Multi-tenancy shard isolation (weaviate-docs-7) is a data-separation feature, not an access-control mechanism, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations
